name: Game assets
description: Images for games (sprites, icons, textures, concept art) with OpenAI's gpt-image, directly or through Azure OpenAI, with your own key. Sound and 3D models come next.

tools.name: make_image
tools.description: Make an image with gpt-image and save it as a PNG in the project. Use for game sprites, icons, textures and concept art: describe subject, style, colours and framing in detail. Returns the image so you can check it and try again.

params.name: prompt
params.description: What to draw, in detail: subject, style, colours, framing.

params.name: size
params.description: Pixel size (square, landscape, portrait). Default square.

params.name: transparent
params.description: A transparent background, for sprites and icons.

params.name: name
params.description: File name to save as, without extension (default: from the prompt).

tools.cost: about $0.01 to $0.25 an image, by size and quality
